prompt:
Create an EXACT pose-for-pose animation retarget of the FIRST reference image, which is Uzudi's shipped movement guide, onto the character identity in the SECOND reference image, AmirReza. Output one transparent RGBA production sprite source sheet. It has EXACTLY FOUR ROWS and EIGHT COLUMNS, 32 completely isolated full-body poses.

The FIRST reference is the authoritative movement model: match each corresponding cell's hip position, lean, bent knees, forearm angles, hand placement, planted/raised feet, opposing arm-leg movement, balance and wing opening/folding. The SECOND reference provides identity ONLY: friendly young adult man with warm olive skin, short BLACK CURLY hair, dark eyes and thick eyebrows, small moustache and short beard stubble, untucked royal cobalt BLUE open-collar button-down shirt, white buttons, rolled sleeves, navy trousers, black sneakers with cream soles/laces and black/silver watch on anatomical left wrist. He has ONE PAIR of WHITE feathered wings attached to his back in EVERY pose, not Uzudi's black wings. Keep the AmirReza face, hair, blue outfit and white-wing identity exactly consistent with the second reference. Do not copy Uzudi's moustache, tattoos, ear gauges, shorts or black shirt.

Use AmirReza's existing polished detailed chibi pixel illustration style, dark clean outlines, about three heads tall. All 32 poses have the SAME HEAD SIZE and body proportions. No squash/stretch, shrinking a pose, separate floating feathers, companion, weapon, particles, floor shadow or effects.

ROW 1 = WALK: follow the eight left-to-right WALK poses of the first reference's row 1, with its relaxed opposing arm-leg gait, contact and passing phases, folded white wings swaying gently.
ROW 2 = WING-ASSISTED RUN: follow the eight corresponding poses in the first reference's row 2 exactly, including its bent elbow positions, knee drive, forward lean and wing flap rhythm. These eight poses form the same cycle as Uzudi, with readable moving arms and legs.
ROW 3 = JUMP: follow the eight corresponding poses in the first reference's row 3 exactly: low anticipation crouch, push-off, rise, compact apex with raised arms and spread wings, balanced apex, descent with wings folding, leg extension, low soft landing preparation. Keep arms and legs in the same configuration as each matching Uzudi cell.
ROW 4 = LAND: follow the eight corresponding landing/recovery poses in the first reference's row 4: deep knee bend and folded white wings, gradual recovery, then relaxed upright. No flying in this row.

Every figure faces RIGHT/east in the same slightly three-quarter view as the guide. EXACT 8 columns x 4 rows with consistent baselines, uniform pose scale and generous fully TRANSPARENT horizontal/vertical gutters. Feather tips, hair, shoes, knees, hands and wings must stay completely inside the cell with at least 20px transparent margin and NEVER touch a neighbor, another row or the image border. The entire expanded wing and body are visible in every cell. TRUE alpha transparency with no text, grid lines, checkerboard, labels or background. This is a source animation sheet, not a poster.
references: Uzudi walk/run/jump/land source poses assembled as a guide
